Bone health, muscle function and immunity. In PEI (~46°N) the sun is too weak to make vitamin D from about October to March.
Targets: Goal = RDA 15 µg (600 IU), which NASEM set assuming minimal sun — so it already covers a PEI winter. No higher target: the Endocrine Society 2024 guideline (replacing its 2011 advice of 1500–2000 IU) recommends against routine doses above the DRI for healthy adults under 75. A supplement is reasonable if food falls short or a blood test is low. Stay under the 100 µg (4000 IU) UL. 1 µg = 40 IU.
